title: Degreewise ordinary tensor normalization descends to the homotopy category
statement: For any morphism φ:Λ→A of commutative condensed ring objects, scheme morphism f:X→Y, and homotopy complex P of Λ_Y-modules, use the ordinary module square and coefficient e of [new-integral-residue-ordinary-tensor-square], the tensor presentation of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-reduction-tensor], and tensorModelCoefficient of [new-integral-residue-tensor-model]. Let B,Bprime be the restricted regular A-modules, F integral pullback, and eH the homotopy image of e using the map-single comparison. On P, inverse restriction/pullback, restriction of inverse scalar pullback, tensor presentation on X, inverse tensor-single comparison for Bprime and tensoring eH inverse equal Fh of the Y tensor presentation and inverse tensor-single comparison, followed by the homotopy oplax tensor map. This equality assumes no flatness and involves no derived categories.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15 and proof of Lemma 6.5.9(5), p. 51; explicit formal normalization by derived counits (agent calculation, not a separate statement in the paper)

proof.text: Represent P by a cochain complex K. Apply the ordinary module square in each degree; the natural transformations provide commutation with the differentials. Apply the quotient functor to obtain the corresponding homotopy equality.

For an arbitrary additive monoidal functor F and coefficient isomorphism e:F(B)≅Bprime, expand the inverse tensor-single comparison on a quotient object. At the complex level, compare the two composites on each tensor summand using the inverse-image tensorator naturality and the map-single isomorphism in degree zero. Map this equality through the quotient, whose monoidal tensor comparison and map-homotopy factors are the identity on representatives.
Combine the degreewise scalar equality with this generic tensor-single identity and cancel tensoring the homotopy coefficient isomorphism with its inverse. Reassemble functorial composition.

theorem residueOrdinaryTensorPull_homotopy
    (Λ A : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] [MonObj A] [IsCommMonObj A]
    (φ : Λ ⟶ A) [IsMonHom φ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : HomotopyCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))
      (.up ℤ)) :
    let F := (f)^*⟦Λ⟧
    let TY := Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap φ Y)
    let SX := Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (coefficientMap φ X)
    let SY := Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (coefficientMap φ Y)
    let B := SY.obj (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj A Y))
    let B' := SX.obj (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj A X))
    let FP := (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let TP := (TY.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let _ := residueOrdinaryUpperStarMonoidal Λ f
    let e : F.obj B ≅ B' :=
      residueOrdinaryRestrictedRegularPullIso Λ A φ f
    let eH : (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj (Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B) ≅
        Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B' :=
      (F.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (.up ℤ)).app
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj B) ≪≫
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).mapIso
        ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app B ≪≫
          (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).mapIso e)
    (NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory (comapUpperStarIso φ f).inv (.up ℤ)).app TP ≫
      (SX.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory (pullIso φ f).inv (.up ℤ)).app P) ≫
      (Mod.tensorPresentationHomotopyIso (coefficientMap φ X)).hom.app FP ≫
      (homotopyTensorSingleIso B').inv.app FP ≫ eH.inv ▷ FP =
    (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map
        ((Mod.tensorPresentationHomotopyIso (coefficientMap φ Y)).hom.app P ≫
          (homotopyTensorSingleIso B).inv.app P) ≫
      ((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.mapHomotopyCategoryδNatTrans (.up ℤ) F).app
        (Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B)).app P
